final: WITH pair_rates AS (SELECT o.mktnote, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_rate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink GROUP BY o.mktnote), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) AS mean_pair_rate FROM pair_rates), above AS (SELECT p.avg_net_rate, p.avg_net_rate - b.mean_pair_rate AS excess_rate FROM pair_rates p CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.mean_pair_rate IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_net_rate > b.mean_pair_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) AS average_above_pair_rate, AVG(excess_rate) AS average_excess_over_benchmark FROM above
